context: You come upon a recently killed courier whose loyal dog is standing guard over the body. In the SwA version, the dog—Scratch—speaks like a calm, well‑spoken human: stoic, heartbroken, and adamantly convinced his master will still wake despite the evidence. Scratch says they were set upon by cackling, furry humanoids and notices a rotten, evil smell; he will not let you near the corpse or the courier’s belongings. You can try to soothe or intimidate him, use Speak with Animals to learn his perspective, or cast Speak with Dead on the courier (which can also reveal the dog’s name); killing Scratch is also an option.
